status: frozen before campaign; v2.1 corrects B1 only (minimum calibration sample 50 -> 30); no v2.1 campaign executed, no model fitted, no test row read at freeze time

campaign_ready_reason: end-to-end readiness is false because execution_ready is false; this flag does not describe protocol completeness, which is complete: protocol_fields_open is empty and no blocking issue remains

supersedes.rule: v1 is preserved byte-for-byte and is never edited or re-baselined; v1 remains authoritative only for the historical smoke run whose fitted.json fingerprints it; v1 must not be used for a v2 campaign

immediate_predecessor.rule: v2 is preserved byte-for-byte and is never edited; it remains the record of the approved design before the B1 correction, and it is not campaign-usable because B1 blocked L7 calibration

inherits_from_v1.rule: the following blocks are frozen in protocol.json and are incorporated by reference, not restated, so that two sources of truth cannot drift apart
inherits_from_v1.features: v1 #/features (feature sets L0-L7, definitions, forbidden columns)
inherits_from_v1.preprocessing: v1 #/preprocessing (train-only median imputation, constant-feature drop, train-only scaling, no feature selection, no hyperparameter search)

inherits_from_v1.campaign_modes: v1 #/campaign/modes (smoke Q00/Q01/Q04 'fit'; full 5.0 d 'fit' then 'test'; sensitivity 3.0 d 'fit' then 'test')
inherits_from_v1.note: any v2 field that conflicts with v1 overrides v1 and is listed in changelog_vs_v1

changelog_vs_v1.change: replaces the v1 rule 'max(3.0, p95) then raise to the next observed score' with an exact finite-sample algorithm whose candidate set includes the interpolated quantile t0
changelog_vs_v1.reason: v1 code (phase11.py:530) never allows the interpolated quantile to be returned, so the threshold is not reproducible from the protocol text and can be over-lifted

changelog_vs_v1.change: floor binding is strict (floor > quantile) and is recorded as floor_binding; v1 used '>=' (phase11.py:543)
changelog_vs_v1.reason: when floor == quantile the floor does not select the value, and the provenance label must say so

changelog_vs_v1.change: adds threshold_source with precedence tie_lift > floor > quantile
changelog_vs_v1.reason: quantile selection and tie-lifting must be distinguishable in the audit trail

changelog_vs_v1.change: adds detector_valid; a window with no valid grid candidate is snr = -inf and counts as not detected, never dropped
changelog_vs_v1.reason: silently dropping invalid candidates biases every rate upward

changelog_vs_v1.change: primary reporting is per noise stratum; pooled is secondary and descriptive
changelog_vs_v1.reason: the two noise conditions have different score distributions; pooling hides that

changelog_vs_v1.change: authoritative false-positive-rate estimate is the per-stratum rate with a Clopper-Pearson one-sided upper bound when zero false positives are observed; Wilson is secondary, trial-level and anti-conservative
changelog_vs_v1.reason: v1 stated 'Wilson and cluster' without defining which interval is authoritative or what it assumes

changelog_vs_v1.change: percentile bootstrap is primary; BCa is secondary and diagnostic
changelog_vs_v1.reason: BCa acceleration estimated from five clusters is too noisy to be the primary interval

changelog_vs_v1.change: adds the pre-registered L7-versus-physics detector contrast, the 0.02 absolute FPR-mismatch gate, the intersection-union rule across strata, the heterogeneity guard, and the degenerate-interval rule
changelog_vs_v1.reason: v1 pre-registered no detector-versus-ML comparison criterion at all

changelog_vs_v1.change: replaces the v1 existence-check ledger with one-way O_EXCL markers, atomic trials rename, and fail-closed gates on every interruption and concurrency case
changelog_vs_v1.reason: the v1 ledger was check-then-write and therefore racy, and a crashed run left no evidence of a consumed read

changelog_vs_v1.change: adds commit id, clean-tree gate, dirty flag, source-manifest hash, offsets and manifest hashes, and interpreter package versions to the fitted artifact
changelog_vs_v1.reason: v1 fitted.json recorded no source revision or environment, so a run could not be tied to a code state

changelog_vs_v1.change: min_calibration_n_per_stratum lowered from 50 to 30 in v2.1 (L7 validation-null pool is 42 per stratum); documents the quantisation of the operating point, the no-fallback rule, and the threshold saturation rule
changelog_vs_v1.reason: closes blocking issue B1 without pooling strata or relaxing the target false-positive rate

approval_decisions.rule: each decision is recorded verbatim as approved, with its consequence; a decision marked 'human' is not implementable from code and must not be inferred by the software

D1_minimum_meaningful_difference.consequence: conclusions are descriptive-only; practical-superiority claims are prohibited; statistical superiority may be described only if the prespecified comparison supports it, with the limited power of the design and the five-cluster structure disclosed

D2_timing_tolerance_days.note: rounded value retained for continuity with the frozen v1 artifacts; difference 3.7e-5 d (about 3.2 s), roughly 1.5 percent of one grid step; changing it would reclassify boundary trials

D3_heterogeneity_guard.rule: if at least 2 of the 5 test quarters have a recall-difference sign opposite to the pooled difference, the comparison is inconclusive
D3_heterogeneity_guard.zero_difference_case: if the pooled difference is exactly 0.0 the sign is undefined and the result is inconclusive by rule

D4_primary_model.note: L6-style ablation of min_depth_ppm stays diagnostic and is excluded from every realistic-detection claim

D5_fpr_matched_sensitivity.rule: it may never override, replace, or rescue the primary result, and may not be selected after seeing test outcomes

D6_bind_hashes.rule: offsets.json and every required manifest and sidecar hash are bound into this protocol; see frozen_inputs

D7_bootstrap.value: percentile primary; BCa secondary and diagnostic
D7_bootstrap.pairing: common resample indices are shared by both methods so the difference is paired at cluster level
D7_bootstrap.limitation: only 5 clusters; resample count is not evidence of independent units

D8_min_calibration_n_per_stratum.status: approved by owner authorization for B1 only
D8_min_calibration_n_per_stratum.consequence: L7 becomes calibratable at 42 nulls per stratum; the operating point is quantised and conservative, and this must be stated wherever the operating point is reported

data_roles.detector_calibration: all null_window trials with split in {train, val}, per noise_condition
data_roles.detector_calibration_reason: the physics detector has no fitted parameters; its threshold is the only estimated quantity, so maximising calibration nulls cannot leak a label
data_roles.l7_calibration: all null_window trials with split == val, per noise_condition
data_roles.l7_calibration_reason: L7 is fitted on train windows, so train null scores are in-sample and would inflate the threshold; only validation nulls are admissible
data_roles.test_usage: one generation of sealed test trials and one final evaluation; test rows never enter fitting, feature selection, imputation, scaling, threshold calibration, or hyperparameter choice
data_roles.leakage_invariant: no test row may be read before fitted.json is frozen and hashed, and no test outcome may influence any value recorded in this protocol
data_roles.paired_controls: excluded from calibration, from every false-positive-rate denominator, and from the confirmatory comparison

detection.timing_error_definition: timing_error_days = delta_est_days - delta_true_days, signed; the absolute value is applied only inside the recovery test
detection.separation: detection recall and timing-qualified recovery are separate metrics; neither substitutes for the other; detection recall is the confirmatory metric
detection.invalid_candidate_rule: detector_valid = false means not detected and not recovered; it stays in every denominator
detection.grid_determinism: the detector grid, template, argmax tie-break (strict >, earliest candidate on exact ties) and sign conventions are those of research/core.py and are unchanged by this protocol

thresholds.target_fpr_meaning: the nominal rate on the calibration pool, not the achieved rate on test
thresholds.min_calibration_n_status: lowered from 50 to 30 by owner authorization on 2026-10-22, for B1 only; the L7 validation-null pool is 42 per stratum and therefore clears the minimum with 12 trials of headroom
thresholds.quantile_definition: q = linear-interpolated (1 - target_fpr) quantile of the finite calibration scores of that stratum
thresholds.floor_binding_rule: floor_binding := (floor is not null) AND (floor > q); strict comparison
thresholds.working_value_rule: t0 := max(q, floor) when floor is not null, else q
thresholds.candidate_set_rule: C := sorted unique of ({t0} UNION {x in scores : x >= t0})
thresholds.selection_rule: threshold := min { t in C : e(t) <= target_fpr }
thresholds.existence_argument: e(max score) = 0 <= target_fpr, so C always contains a qualifying value and the threshold is always defined for any finite calibration sample; for the interpolated quantile e(t0) <= (n-1)/n * target_fpr < target_fpr, so the minimum never needs to exceed t0 for the quantile, and when the floor binds t0 = floor
thresholds.exceedance_guarantee: the returned threshold always satisfies t >= max(q, floor) and e(t) <= 0.05 by construction; the v1 failure branch 'tie rule could not bring calibration exceedance under target' is unreachable in v2 and survives only as a defensive assertion
thresholds.interpolation_note: q and t0 are float64 values with no rounding; the threshold is either exactly t0 or an observed calibration score
thresholds.tie_note: candidates are unique observed scores, so equal scores cannot yield different thresholds; ties inside the distribution are absorbed by the strict > counting rule, which is why a threshold may sit exactly on a tied value and still satisfy the exceedance bound
threshold_source_precedence: 2. else if floor is not null AND floor > q -> threshold_source = 'floor'
thresholds.threshold_source_notes: evaluated in order and mutually exclusive; when floor == q the floor does not bind, so the label is 'quantile'; 'tie_lift' takes precedence because a lifted threshold is no longer equal to the floor and selection, not the floor, produced the final value
thresholds.test_controls_excluded: no test null or test injection score may enter any calibration computation
thresholds.no_fallback_rule: a stratum with fewer than the minimum calibration nulls is not calibrated; it is not pooled with the other stratum, the target false-positive rate is not relaxed, alpha is not raised, and the stratum is not dropped to rescue the comparison; the stratum and the overall comparison are reported as inconclusive

calibration_resolution.granularity_l7: 1/42 = 0.0238; the largest calibration exceedance the rule may leave at n = 42 is 2/42 = 0.0476, so the realised exceedance can only be 0, 0.0238 or 0.0476
calibration_resolution.granularity_at_minimum: at n = 30 the allowed exceedance is at most 1/30 = 0.0333, so a stratum calibrated at the minimum cannot reach the 5 percent target and is systematically conservative
calibration_resolution.effective_resolution_caveat: resolution is set by the number of distinct calibration scores, not by n; heavily tied scores reduce it further, and the realised operating point may sit materially below the 5 percent target as a result
calibration_resolution.consequence: the calibrated operating point is quantised and conservative; the achieved test false-positive rate is expected to sit at or below target, and any shortfall is not evidence of a better detector; neither point estimates nor intervals may be reported without stating these quantisation limits
calibration_resolution.no_compensation: the target rate is not raised and no interpolation or smoothing of the score distribution is introduced to recover resolution

tie_and_saturation_rules.exceedance_target_always_satisfiable: true; because e(max calibration score) = 0 <= target, ties can never make the calibration constraint unsatisfiable, so the threshold is always defined
what_ties_can_do: collapse the threshold onto the maximum observed calibration score
reduce effective resolution below 1/n when many scores are identical
produce a threshold equal to the upper bound of the score range
tie_and_saturation_rules.saturation_rule: if the selected threshold is greater than or equal to the supremum of the achievable score range for that model (1.0 for probability outputs), the strict '>' detection rule can never fire; the operating point is then marked threshold_degenerate = true, the stratum is reported as having no usable operating point, and the comparison is inconclusive
tie_and_saturation_rules.saturation_is_not_a_target_failure: a degenerate threshold still satisfies the calibration exceedance bound; it fails operability, not exceedance, and the two must be reported separately
tie_and_saturation_rules.lower_saturation_note: a threshold equal to the minimum achievable score is not degenerate: strict '>' then detects every trial, which is reported as an operating point with false-positive rate 1.0 and is not silently discarded

pooled_secondary_denominators.status: secondary and descriptive; pooled results may not upgrade a primary inconclusive outcome

reporting.unit_of_dependence: the Kepler quarter; any interval that claims coverage must resample quarters

sources: windows_primary.json (window slots and their split and role)
denominator_derivation.control_trials_per_injection_slot: 1 control depth x offset_draws(2) x noise_conditions(2) = 4
denominator_derivation.consistency_requirement: the runner recomputes these denominators from the frozen inputs before any evaluation and raises GateError on any mismatch with the literals above; the literals are pre-registration, not data
denominator_derivation.verified_at_freeze: totals 2040 injected, 408 controls, 420 nulls reproduce experiment_config.json projected_cost exactly

reporting.paired_control_identification: paired controls carry role='injection' with requested_depth_ppm = 0.0 and injected = false; null_window trials carry role='null_window' with requested_depth_ppm = 0.0; exclusion from the false-positive-rate denominator is therefore by role, never by depth, because a depth filter would conflate the two
reporting.never_reported: no rate without its numerator, denominator, stratum, and interval method

fpr.point_estimate: k / n with n = 76 per stratum (152 pooled, secondary)

primary_interval.positive_count: two-sided 95 percent Clopper-Pearson interval, labelled trial-level

secondary_interval.label: trial-level and anti-conservative under within-quarter dependence; never described as cluster-adjusted

fpr.cluster_reporting: a quarter-level bootstrap of the false-positive rate is reported as a diagnostic only; with 5 quarters it is weakly identified and may not be used to declare the target met or unmet
fpr.target_vs_achieved: 0.05 is the calibration target; the achieved test rate is reported with its interval and is never described as achieving 5 percent
fpr.zero_count_interpretation: 0 of 76 is consistent with a true stratum rate as high as 3.87 percent at 95 percent confidence; no 1 percent target is claimed or implied anywhere

comparison.comparator: physics matched-filter detector at its calibrated per-stratum threshold
comparison.confirmatory_contrast: per-stratum detection recall difference, L7 minus physics detector
comparison.primary_metric: detection recall at the calibrated operating point

paired_resampling.secondary_method: BCa, with the quarter-level jackknife as the acceleration estimate
paired_resampling.shared_indices: both methods consume the same resample index vectors
paired_resampling.statistic: trial-weighted recall difference over all test injected trials in the resampled quarters

comparison.auxiliary_report: per-quarter recall for both methods as a descriptive table with no confirmatory weight

fpr_operating_point_gate.rule: for each stratum, if abs(fpr_l7 - fpr_physics) > 0.02, that stratum's recall comparison is inconclusive for superiority
fpr_operating_point_gate.basis: achieved test false-positive rates, point estimates
fpr_operating_point_gate.known_limitation: with 76 null trials per stratum the gate has low resolution and mostly detects large mismatches; passing it is not proof that operating points are matched

fpr_matched_sensitivity.rule: may not replace, override, or rescue the primary result and may not be chosen after seeing test outcomes

heterogeneity_guard.rule: if at least 2 of 5 test quarters show a recall-difference sign opposite to the pooled difference, the comparison is inconclusive
heterogeneity_guard.zero_case: a pooled difference of exactly 0.0 makes the outcome inconclusive

triggers: fewer than 3 of 5 quarters contributing a non-zero paired difference
unreliable_interval_rule.prohibition: an unreliable interval is never interpreted as equivalence, as no effect, or as evidence of superiority

comparison.decision_rule: L7 is superior only if every confirmatory stratum has a reliable interval whose lower bound exceeds 0, the per-stratum false-positive-rate mismatch is at most 0.02, the heterogeneity guard does not fire, and the minimum-data rules are met; otherwise the outcome is inconclusive or not superior, and inconclusive is mandatory whenever reliability, the mismatch gate, the guard, or the minimum-data rules fail
comparison.practical_superiority: prohibited: the minimum meaningful difference is unset, so no practical-superiority claim may be made

multiplicity.family: the per-stratum detection-recall contrast across the two noise strata
multiplicity.rule: intersection-union: superiority requires every stratum in the family to satisfy the decision rule independently; this controls family-wise error without further correction
multiplicity.consequence: an effect confined to one stratum cannot be declared; that is the conservative direction and is accepted

comparison.diagnostic_only: the min_depth_ppm ablation (L4 versus L5, and the L6 comparisons) uses injected ground truth and is excluded from every realistic-detection claim; injected ground truth is never a detector input in the primary model
comparison.prohibited_claims: no real-planet discovery claim; no generalisation from synthetic injection results to real Kepler or TESS targets; no claim that higher recall implies discovery capability; no claim of matched operating points from the 0.02 gate

bootstrap.report: interval, method, cluster count (5), and resample count
bootstrap.limitation: five clusters; the resample count is not a count of independent units; intervals are reported as weakly identified and any unreliable result is inconclusive

insufficient_data.action_on_failure: the affected stratum is reported as not evaluated with the reason and the observed count; the overall comparison is inconclusive; no substitute denominator, no rescue by pooling, no reweighting
insufficient_data.current_status: all minima are met: 5 test clusters, 76 test nulls and 72 injections per depth per stratum on the test side, 134 calibration nulls per stratum for the detector and 42 per stratum for L7
insufficient_data.minimum_calibration_n_status: aligned with thresholds.min_calibration_n_per_stratum = 30 after the B1 correction

test_access.state_machine: each marker permits exactly one transition: absent -> started -> completed; there is no other transition
test_access.creation: O_CREAT|O_EXCL; the started record is written before any test row is generated or read
test_access.one_way: markers are never reset, deleted, renamed, truncated, or reused by any software path in this repository
test_access.interrupted_run: a marker left in started is terminal evidence of an interrupted run and every later attempt must refuse
test_access.no_automatic_remediation: no function removes or rewrites a marker; remediation requires an explicit human-authorized manual action outside the software and must be documented separately
test_access.trials_commit: test trials are written to a temporary file in the destination directory and atomically renamed; the sha256 of the committed file is recorded in the generation marker
test_access.evaluation_gate: evaluate_test refuses unless the generation marker is completed, the trials sha256 matches the recorded value, the access marker is absent, the protocol_v2 hash matches, the fitted.json hash matches its sidecar, and the source tree is clean at the recorded commit
test_access.early_access_guard: any test read, generation, or evaluation is refused while fitted.json or its sidecar is missing, or while any hash check fails
test_access.concurrency: O_EXCL makes concurrent starts mutually exclusive; the loser fails closed; no lock or marker is treated as authoritative after a crash
test_access.repeated_evaluation: a second evaluation in the same process and any evaluation after a restart are refused
failure_modes_fail_closed: protocol, offset, manifest, fitted, or trials hash mismatch -> GateError, no fallback path
any marker present in any state -> GateError
interrupted run left started -> GateError on retry, with no retry loop
truncated or partial trials file -> sha mismatch -> GateError
process restart -> on-disk marker still blocks re-entry

required_before_campaign: git commit id of HEAD and branch name
tracked working tree clean; untracked files permitted only if enumerated in the run report
dirty flag recorded even when the gate passes, so a dirty run can never be described as clean
sha256 of offsets.json and its sidecar
sha256 of all five manifests and experiment_config.json
python version and exact numpy, pandas and scikit-learn versions read from the running interpreter
sha256 of the enumerated Phase 11 source manifest
provenance.clean_tree_policy: a campaign requires a clean tracked tree and a HEAD equal to the recorded commit; otherwise the campaign aborts before any window is read
provenance.fitted_json_must_contain: protocol hash, offsets hash, manifest hashes, commit id, dirty flag, source manifest hash, model seed, hyperparameters, library versions, training row count, per-stratum threshold table with provenance, and the trials fingerprint
provenance.hash_meaning: a hash establishes artifact identity only; it does not establish scientific validity, which is why this protocol is approved on content as well as hash

frozen_inputs.rule: byte-for-byte immutable; the sidecars are the authority for the JSON hashes; any mismatch with these values is a GateError

historical_smoke.status: pre-v2; fingerprints protocol v1; not evidence for v2; must never be modified or regenerated

invalid_scope_quarantine.status: INVALID; retained for process audit only; must never be used for any scientific inference and never modified

campaign_requirements.protocol_selection: run_campaign requires schema_version 2 and a hash match against protocol_v2.sha256; protocol v1 is accepted only for reproducing the historical smoke run
preconditions: clean tracked tree at the recorded commit
protocol, offsets and all manifest hashes verified
no test_generation.json and no test_access.json present
fitted.json, model.pkl and fitted.sha256 frozen and hashed before any test read
campaign_requirements.excluded_scope: the 3-day sensitivity campaign enters no confirmatory claim; the TESS sector is excluded from the split and is descriptive only
